title: Dewlap & Hoof
text:
Dewlap - a fold or flap of skin on the neck of a cow.

Function of the dewlap is unknown but it was hypothesize for:
1. Sexual signalling
2. To appear bigger
3. To dissipate heat

Hoof
• Cattle are cloven-footed animals, meaning that the hoof consists of two digits, instead of a solid part like that of a horse.

facts: A dewlap is defined as a fold or flap of skin on the neck of a cow.
The exact function of the dewlap is officially unknown.
One hypothesized function of the dewlap is sexual signalling.
Another hypothesized function of the dewlap is to appear bigger.
A third hypothesized function of the dewlap is to dissipate heat.
Being cloven-footed means that the cattle hoof consists of two digits rather than a single solid part.
A horse's hoof consists of a solid part, in contrast to the two-digit cloven hoof of cattle.

options.B: Their hoof contains four fully functional digits for walking
options.C: Their hoof forms a single solid round structure

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the hoof structure of cattle versus horses is true?

options.A: Cattle have a solid undivided hoof, whereas horses have two digits.
options.B: Cattle hooves consist of two digits, whereas a horse's hoof consists of a solid part.
options.C: Both cattle and horses are cloven-footed animals with two functional digits.
options.D: Neither cattle nor horses have digits in their hoof structures.

options.B: Its exact function is unknown, but several functions are hypothesized.
options.C: It serves solely to produce milk precursors during lactation.
options.D: It acts primarily as an organ of hearing and balance.
